`final class TextStyle`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TextStyle.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/TextStyle.java)

The running style of the characters while a text is laid out, which markup tags change as they are read.

## Description

A text renderer starts from [`TextInfo.getStyle`](/reference/text/textinfo/#TextInfo-method-getStyle), derives a working copy, and hands it to each [`ITextMarkup`](/reference/text/itextmarkup/) it meets: a tag of yours can set the weight, the color, the font or the effects of the characters that follow, and a closing tag resets them.
Each glyph keeps a copy of the style it was laid out with.

- [Text markup and effects](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/text-markup-and-effects/)

## Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [font](#TextStyle-property-font) | [`IFont`](/reference/text/ifont/) | set at creation | The font of the characters, or `null` to keep the font of the [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/); a font drawn by another text renderer is ignored with a dev-mode warning. |

| [weight](#TextStyle-property-weight) | [`FontWeight`](/reference/text/fontweight/) | set at creation | The [`FontWeight`](/reference/text/fontweight/) of the characters. |
